snippet.title: Pillar of Salt Demo Release Date Trailer | Indie Roguelike RPG
snippet.description:
The deity of this world has decided to destroy it in three days. His avatar awaits the world's champion at the top of the Mountain of Power. Can you build up your strength in time and reach the mountain in this unique real-time tactical roguelike RPG?
